description:
TravelPulse: Global travel intelligence API for AI agents: weather, hotel deals, theme-park wait times, translation, trip plans, visas, health, currency, insurance, points. Any destination + language. x402 USDC (Base + Solana); no accounts, no keys.

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • waits ($0.05): Live park wait times
  • hours ($0.05): Park hours and schedule
  • crowds ($0.08): Crowd prediction
  • weather ($0.15): Travel weather forecast
  • deals ($0.08): Travel deals
  • plan ($0.20): Trip itinerary
  • visa ($0.08): Visa requirements by nationality and destination
  • insurance ($0.08): Travel insurance comparison and recommendation
  • pack ($0.10): AI packing list by destination, climate, and activities
  • budget ($0.10): Daily travel budget by destination and style
  • currency ($0.08): Currency exchange rates and money tips for destination
  • phrasebook ($0.05): Essential travel phrasebook by destination language
  • translate ($0.03): Real-time travel translation (menus, signs, conversations)
  • health ($0.08): Destination health advisories and vaccine requirements
  • fare-intel ($0.12): Flight fare intelligence — when to book, cheapest months
  • points ($0.12): Points & miles redemption optimizer
  • trip-check ($0.50): One-call pre-booking trip clearance (visa + health + safety + weather + money)
  • disruption ($0.25): Flight disruption risk for an airport and date
  • check ($0.05): Flight compensation eligibility — EU261 / UK261 / Canada APPR / Brazil ANAC 400 / Turkey SHY / India DGCA (deterministic)
  • letter ($2.00): Citation-backed flight compensation claim letter (6 regimes, ready to send)

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: waits | hours | crowds | weather | deals | plan | visa | insurance | pack | budget | currency | phrasebook | translate | health | fare-intel | points | trip-check | disruption | check | letter

activities.description: Planned activities (e.g. hiking, beach, business, diving, winter sports)

airport.description: Airport IATA code or city (e.g. JFK, Heathrow, Frankfurt)

amount.description: Amount to convert for reference calculation

bag_received_date.description: Baggage claims: date the bag was returned/received (YYYY-MM-DD) — computes the Art. 31 complaint deadline

block_time_hours.description: India DGCA cancellations: scheduled block time in hours (estimated from distance if omitted, labeled [ESTIMATE])

carrier_country.description: Operating carrier home country ISO code, or EU (default EU)

claim_value.description: Baggage claims: documented damages with currency (e.g. '480 USD') — demanded in the letter, capped by the Montreal limit

delay_hours.description: Arrival delay at final destination in hours (e.g. 4.5)

disruption.description: delay | cancellation | denied_boarding | baggage_delay | baggage_damage | baggage_loss (default delay)

distance_km.description: Great-circle distance override for airports outside the reference table

focus.description: Phrase focus area (transport, food, emergency, shopping, all)

from.description: Home currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP) — default: USD

goal.description: Redemption goal, e.g. 'business class to Japan' or 'free hotel week in Europe'

nationality.description: Traveler nationality — some vaccines required only for specific nationals

park.description: Park name or slug e.g. magic-kingdom, universal-studios-florida, europa-park

passport.description: Passport nationality (e.g. US, UK, India, Brazil, Nigeria). `nationality` accepted as an alias.

programs.description: Comma-separated list of programs/cards the user holds

reason.description: Cause per the carrier (default unknown — burden of proof is the carrier's)

region.description: Country/region the user holds cards/programs in

trip_cost_usd.description: Total prepaid trip cost in USD — for cancellation coverage sizing

name: travelpulse
